Class StreamParser

java.lang.Object
org.infosmid.stream.dsl.AppParser
org.infosmid.stream.dsl.StreamParser
public class StreamParser extends AppParser
Parser for stream DSL that generates StreamNode.

    • eatSourceDestination

      protected SourceDestinationNode eatSourceDestination()
      If the current token position contains a source destination, return a SourceDestinationNode and advance the token position; otherwise return null.

      Expected format: ':' identifier > ':' identifier '.' identifier >

      Returns:
      a SourceDestinationNode or null if the token position is not pointing at a source destination

    • eatSinkDestination

      protected SinkDestinationNode eatSinkDestination()
      If the current token position contains a sink destination, return a SinkDestinationNode and advance the token position; otherwise return null.

      Expected format: '>' ':' identifier

      Returns:
      a SinkDestinationNode or null if the token position is not pointing at a sink destination

    • eatDestinationReference

      protected DestinationNode eatDestinationReference(boolean canDefault)
      Return a DestinationNode for the token at the current position.

      A destination reference is the label component when referencing a specific app/label in a stream definition.

      Expected format: ':' identifier [ '.' identifier ]*

      Parameters:
      canDefault - allows the user to peek ahead to parse a reference when working with colons in the syntax.
      Returns:
      DestinationNode representing the destination reference

    • eatAppList

      protected List<AppNode> eatAppList(boolean preceedingSourceChannelSpecified)
      Return a list of AppNode starting from the current token position.

      Expected formats: appList: app (| app)* A stream may end in an app (if it is a sink) or be followed by a sink destination.

      Parameters:
      preceedingSourceChannelSpecified - indicator to parser about state of stream.
      Returns:
      a list of AppNode
